Deputy CM Pawan Kalyan Names New Plant Species, Highlights Conservation

Andhra Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Pawan Kalyan has named a newly discovered plant species. He stated that humans must learn to coexist with nature and emphasized the state's adoption of a science-driven approach to tiger conservation. The coverage highlights his involvement in environmental initiatives.
